==Description==
'''Pizza Party''' is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] that adds masks onto enemies. It also increases all currency rewards by 10%.

'''Pizza Party''' exclusively appears in [[Pizza Party]]; it is active in all matches on that map.

==Effects==
===Enemy Appearance===
'''Pizza Party''' modifier has a chance to add masks onto enemies. All the masks that can be added are as follows:
<gallery>
PizzaPartyFreddy.png|Bear
PizzaPartyChica.png|Bird
PizzaPartyBonnie.png|Bunny
PizzaPartyFoxy.png|Fox
PizzaPartyDream.png|Mask
</gallery>

===Wave Layout===
Prior to [[Pizza Party]] being moved to the [[Challenge Maps]] system, '''Pizza Party''' modifier changes certain enemies into their pizzeria variants. The changes were as follows<ref name="challenge">These changes still persist in [[Pizza Party]] due to them being tied to its challenge.</ref>:
*The [[Scout (Pizza Party)|Scout]] used to replace the [[Abnormal Boss]].
*The [[Monkey]] used to replace the [[Fallen]].
*The [[Shotgunner (Pizza Party)|Shotgunner]] used to replace the [[Giant Boss]].
*The [[Balloon Kid]] used to replace the [[Hazard]].
*The [[Commander (Pizza Party)|Commander]] used to replace the [[Tank]].
*The [[Super Slime|Radioactive Slime]] used to replace the [[Boomer]].
**The [[Super Slime|Radioactive Slime]] also spawned [[Goo]]s upon death.
*The [[Mimic Umbra]] used to replace the [[Fallen Hero]].
*The [[Minigunner (Pizza Party)|Minigunner]] used to replace the [[Fallen Guardian]].
*[[Wox the Fox]] used to replace the [[Fallen King]].

===Enemy Stats===
Prior to [[Pizza Party]] being moved to the [[Challenge Maps]] system, '''Pizza Party''' changed the health of multiple enemies<ref name="challenge"/>:
*[[Skeleton]] health changed to 50 ({{Color|Yes|+35}}).
*[[Super Slime|Radioactive Slime]] health changed to 4,500 ({{Color|No|-3,500}}).
*[[Goo]] health changed to 800 ({{Color|No|-2,200}}).
*[[Warden (Legacy Enemy)|Warden]] health changed to 10,000 ({{Color|Yes|+2,000}}).

==Trivia==
*Most of the masks that can be added onto enemies are a reference to ''Five Nights at Freddy's''. They are based on [[w:c:freddy-fazbears-pizza:Freddy Fazbear|Freddy Fazbear]], [[w:c:freddy-fazbears-pizza:Bonnie|Bonnie]], [[w:c:freddy-fazbears-pizza:Chica|Chica]] and [[w:c:freddy-fazbears-pizza:Foxy|Foxy]]. 
**The [[w:c:freddy-fazbears-pizza:Chica|Chica]] mask's color palette fits more with the [[w:c:freddy-fazbears-pizza:Funtime_Chica|Funtime Chica]] character, a variation of [[w:c:freddy-fazbears-pizza:Chica|Chica]] from ''Pizzeria Simulator''.
**Weirdly, the fifth mask that can be added onto enemies is seemingly based on [https://www.youtube.com/c/dream Dream]'s mask, despite [https://www.youtube.com/c/dream Dream] not being related to ''Five Nights at Freddy's''.
